misprints.note: Printed with omicron in the first syllable; kept as printed.
The Ordstäfve entry appears to end with a comma instead of a full stop.
The article after ἀπιστία in the Oredlighet entry is printed ὁ.
Printed with an acute where a grave would be expected before another word; kept.

uncertain.note: The last vowel is broken type and looks open-topped, so it could be read as κλοπικύς; I wrote κλοπικός, which is the attested form.
The breathings are small. I read smooth breathing on εἰς (the old OCR had εἷς) and rough breathing on ἥκῃ.
The breathing and accent on ὡς are hard to tell apart in the scan.
